audit.why: 58.81% over 522 games — the second-best matchup in my slice and the packet reports no defects. You beat her early and she reclaims it on roams and kiting.
Spikes are placed right: your levels 1-3 before Vault, your first item, her two-item kiting. What needed fixing was which of her abilities does what at each stage.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three wrong mechanics repeated across the page: the blind is put on Vault, Vault is called a knockback that takes her away from you, and the move speed is attributed to Harrier.
audit.why: All three are wrong against Riot's text. The blind is Blinding Assault (Q): 'calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision'. Vault (E) is 'dashes to an enemy, dealing damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands nearby' — it is a dash TOWARD you with a slow and a brief interrupt, not a knockback and not a blind. That inversion is the important one: the page says 'she vaults away' and tells you to bait it as an escape, when it is her way of getting on top of you, and its interrupt is what cancels your Aegis Assault. Finally Harrier is a mark, not a movement passive — Riot: 'Valor periodically marks enemies with Harrier'. The move speed comes from Heightened Senses (W), which is granted 'after she attacks a Harrier target'.
audit.corrected: Blind moved to Blinding Assault, Vault restated as an inbound dash with a slow and an interrupt, and the move speed moved to Heightened Senses.

audit.whatIsWrong: Behind Enemy Lines is never mentioned, even though the page names her roaming as the reason she reclaims the game.
audit.why: Riot's text makes it a channel, and Shield Vault is a point-and-click stun on 13s, so you cancel it outright. That means the ability the page identifies as her win condition is one you can deny on sight in the side lane. Nothing on either layer said so.
audit.corrected: Written into late and the level-6 why.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Engage when it's down' has no number attached, and the longest cooldown in her kit is never mentioned.
audit.why: Vault is 12/11/10/9/8s. Heightened Senses is 50/45/40/35/30s — fifty seconds at rank 1, the longest basic cooldown in the matchup by a distance, and the source of the move speed the page keeps blaming for her kiting. If it is down, she cannot kite you at all. Blinding Assault is 11s down to 9s.
audit.corrected: Vault's 12s and Heightened Senses' 50s written into mid.

edits.after: Two items in she kites on Heightened Senses speed and blinds your autos with Blinding Assault.

edits.after: Face Aegis Assault at Blinding Assault, but Vault's interrupt cancels it

edits.before: Kite with Harrier passive move-speed and never let your W gap close
edits.after: Kite on Heightened Senses speed and never let Shield Vault close

edits.before: Grand Starfall roams rather than wins the 1v1 — she vaults away, so it's even tempo into map pressure, not a kill window.
edits.after: Grand Starfall roams rather than wins the 1v1 — but Behind Enemy Lines is a channel your Shield Vault cancels on sight.

edits.before: Quinn has one of the weakest level 1s and no E-vault yet, so you own the opening. Lead with your point-and-click W stun — it can't be sidestepped like a skillshot, and it slams the gap her Harrier move-speed wants to keep. At level 2 (W+Q) you have a real all-in before her E knockback is online; hold E's directional block to eat her Q poke, then W-stun in and follow with empowered Q. Don't throw a long-range Q at her if she has E up to vault away — bait the vault first.
edits.after: Quinn has one of the weakest level 1s and no Vault yet, so you own the opening. Lead with point-and-click Shield Vault — no skillshot to sidestep, and it closes the gap she wants. At level 2 you have a real all-in before Vault exists. Face Aegis Assault at Blinding Assault, which is where the blind actually comes from, then stun in and follow with empowered Comet Spear. And know what Vault does: it dashes her ONTO you, slows, and briefly interrupts — it is her engage, not her escape.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are still yours: E block walks her Vault-blind and her Q, and your empowered Q out-trades her Harrier pokes. The catch is her E-vault knockback — if she vaults the instant you W in, your combo whiffs and she kites with move-speed, so respect that cooldown and engage when it's down. At 6, Grand Starfall doesn't suddenly win the 1v1 — she'll just disengage — so spend it roaming to a lane she can't, turning your lead into map pressure before she comes online.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are still yours: Aegis Assault eats Blinding Assault and your empowered spear out-trades her. The catch is Vault, and it is not the escape the page implies — it dashes her onto you, slows, and briefly interrupts, which cancels the channel outright. It is 12s at rank 1, so engage inside that gap. The bigger number is Heightened Senses at 50s: that is where her kiting speed comes from, and with it down she cannot run from you at all. At 6, spend Grand Starfall roaming rather than duelling.

edits.before: This is where she takes over. Two items in, Quinn kites you indefinitely on Harrier move-speed, her E-vault blind and knockback blank your W engage, and her roam pressure plus nimble dueling out-class your plateaued damage. You have no sustain to grind it out and your E only blocks one direction. Win this lane outright in the first 10 minutes and snowball the map — if it goes even past two items, she simply runs you down all game.
edits.after: This is where she takes over. Two items in she kites on Heightened Senses speed, Blinding Assault turns off your autos and Vault interrupts your channel, and Aegis Assault only ever covered the front. But her map game has an answer: Behind Enemy Lines is a channel, and a point-and-click Shield Vault cancels it wherever you catch her. Win the lane in the first 10 minutes, and hunt the ult after that.

notes: Three mechanics repeated wrongly across this page. (1) The blind was attributed to Vault; it belongs to Blinding Assault (Q) — 'calls Valor to mark an enemy and hinder its vision'. (2) Vault was called a knockback that carries her away, and the page told the player to bait it as an escape. Riot's text: 'dashes to an enemy, dealing damage and slowing the target's Move Speed. Upon reaching the target, she leaps off the target, briefly interrupting it, and lands nearby.' It is an inbound dash with a slow and an interrupt — it is how she gets ON you, and its interrupt is what cancels your Aegis Assault. Treating her engage as her escape is the kind of error that loses the trade twice. (3) The kiting move speed was credited to Harrier four times; Harrier is a mark, and the speed is Heightened Senses (W), which matters because that is a 50-second cooldown at rank 1 — the longest basic cooldown in the matchup, and with it down she cannot kite at all. BEST ADDITION: Behind Enemy Lines is a channel and Shield Vault is a point-and-click stun on 13s, so the roaming ultimate the page blames for her comeback is one you cancel on sight. It appeared nowhere on either layer.
